title: That’s a Wrap! The Q3 Earnings Season Concludes with a Look at Holiday Shopping from the Retailers
summary: As the holiday shopping season officially gets underway, the retail sector is flashing a clear message: the American consumer is alive, well, and ready to spend... but only if the price is right.
